summary: Tested the Safari Imprimir/Print regression fix in DocumentPreview.js. FIRST PASS FAILED: clicking Imprimir threw 'ReferenceError: group is not defined' from handlePrint, window.print() never called, no iframe injected, and the React red error overlay locked the screen so Cerrar was unreachable. RCA: lines 573-577 of /app/frontend/src/components/DocumentPreview.js had a `/* ... `.date-group` ... */` block-comment inside the html template literal whose UN-ESCAPED backticks closed the outer template literal early. Babel/webpack happily compiled this — the bundled chunk at src_pages_EventDetails_js.chunk.js:1336 shows the text was emitted as the JS expression `.date - group`, which at runtime evaluates `date - group` (both undeclared). Applied a one-line fix: removed the backticks around `.date-group` inside that CSS comment (kept the wording as `.date-group`). Re-ran the Playwright suite — clicking Imprimir now: (a) injects an aria-hidden iframe (verified via MutationObserver), (b) calls win.print() synchronously within the click stack (verified by patching HTMLIFrameElement.prototype.contentWindow getter to wrap print), (c) produces NO console / page errors, (d) cleans up the iframe within ~1.2s, and (e) is reproducible across two consecutive clicks. Regression PASSED: Cerrar/Close still dismisses the preview modal. Note: this regression was the original Safari production failure — Safari likely also threw the same ReferenceError (Safari and Chrome share the same JS parsing on this point); the previous re-deploy did not regress Safari specifically, it regressed ALL browsers, just nobody else had clicked Print after the comment was introduced.
action_items: Confirm the backtick fix matches the team's preferred phrasing — I replaced em-dash with hyphen on the same line as a side-effect of search/replace; functionally identical, but if the styleguide cares about em-dash punctuation in comments, revisit /app/frontend/src/components/DocumentPreview.js L573-577.

Add ESLint rule no-template-curly-in-string OR a project lint that flags un-escaped backticks inside template literals — this same class of bug bricked the production Print silently because compile-time parsing succeeded.
Add a smoke-test for Print: render DocumentPreview with seeded items and assert window.print is called once on click. Even a simple jest+@testing-library test would catch this regression next time.

Consider adding data-testid='document-preview-print-btn' and data-testid='document-preview-close-btn' on /app/frontend/src/components/DocumentPreview.js L685 and L689 for stable automation (right now we query by visible Imprimir/Print text).
critical_code_review_comments: BUG (fixed): /app/frontend/src/components/DocumentPreview.js L573-577 — backticks around `.date-group` inside an html-template-literal closed the outer literal and emitted live JS (`.date - group`) into the compiled bundle, throwing ReferenceError at click time. Any future inline backticks inside the html string (e.g., to highlight CSS class names in comments) must be escaped with \` or rewritten without backticks.

The handlePrint refactor (synchronous doc.open/write/close + immediate win.print) is correct and Safari-safe in principle, but it would not have worked in production regardless because of the bug above. Once that bug was removed, the new strategy works as intended in Chromium.

Iframe cleanup uses setTimeout(1200ms). If the user clicks Print rapidly multiple times, several aria-hidden iframes co-exist briefly. Not a real bug, but consider tracking the previous iframe in a ref and removing it before creating the next.

try/catch around `doc.open/write/close + win.print()` swallows errors silently (L624 '/* swallow */'). For dev mode at least, console.warn(_e) would have surfaced this bug instead of failing silently.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-existing event_14c8a303ed44 (Wedding - TEST - Boda Garcia-Lopez, prop_4ef3ab9801cc with 7 items) for the demo.agency company.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The print path is now: click Imprimir -> handlePrint creates <iframe aria-hidden=true>, document.body.appendChild(iframe), doc.open/write(html)/close, win.focus(), win.print(). All synchronous in the user-gesture stack. Cleanup runs after 1200ms. To re-verify, use the same MutationObserver + HTMLIFrameElement.prototype.contentWindow patch from this iteration to count print() calls (Playwright Chromium does NOT show a print dialog in headless mode, so the only way to verify is to instrument). Note that this exact fix cannot be validated against a real WebKit/Safari from headless Chromium — recommend a manual Safari spot-check on the deployed preview URL.
rca of the issue: Unescaped backticks around `.date-group` inside a JS template literal at DocumentPreview.js:573 closed the outer literal mid-string. Babel/webpack accepted the resulting expression (`.date-group` parsed as `date - group` subtraction) and emitted live code into the compiled chunk. At runtime, clicking Imprimir invoked handlePrint, which threw ReferenceError: group is not defined before `win.print()` was reached. The previous testing iteration did not exercise the Print button, so this slipped through. Fix: remove the inline backticks from the comment (now reads 'Do NOT mark .date-group as ...'). Verified end-to-end: window.print is called and the aria-hidden iframe is injected and torn down cleanly on every click.
